summary: The August 11 screening emphasizes uncertainty-aware nuclear-EOS inference, QGP momentum-broadening corrections for short in-medium path lengths, EIC heavy-quark feasibility baselines, and maturing HEP-ML/statistical-validation infrastructure. Strongest scientific items: GPDiff for correlated EOS uncertainty propagation, improved GLV momentum-broadening corrections, early-EIC heavy-quark projections, the HEP-ML Living Guide, and a rare-event coverage-failure diagnostic.
strongest_paper: arXiv:2608.09678, a Gaussian-process framework for correlated nuclear-EOS uncertainty propagation from microscopic calculations.

papers.title: A Gaussian Process framework for constraining the nuclear equation of state from microscopic calculations with correlated uncertainties
papers.authors_short: Y. G. Lee, J. Kim, T. Zhao, C. Drischler
papers.abstract: Introduces GPDiff, a JAX-based multivariate Gaussian-process framework with automatic differentiation for EOS predictions and derivatives, applied to microscopic asymmetric matter calculations with correlated uncertainties.

papers.title: Improved Regge Kinematics and All-Path-Length Corrections to Momentum Broadening in the Quark-Gluon Plasma
papers.authors_short: Dario van den Berg, Isobel Kolbe
papers.abstract: Extends first-order opacity GLV momentum broadening by adding all-path-length and improved sub-Regge corrections, with largest effects for short path lengths and high exchanged momentum.

papers.title: Prospects for early heavy-quark measurements at the EIC
papers.authors_short: Allencris John Rubesh Rajan, Laboni Manna
papers.abstract: Estimates early-EIC heavy-quark electroproduction yields and eA nuclear modification ratios across Q2, x_Bj, pT, and rapidity, using projected luminosities and nPDFs.

papers.title: The role of thermal photons in a magnetized plasma and their significance in heavy ion collisions
papers.abstract: Studies thermal photon production in magnetized QGP with Landau-level quantization, including magnetic-field, chemical-potential, and chiral-chemical-potential effects.

papers.title: Topological analysis of scale-invariant spatial fluctuations in ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors_short: Salman Khurshid Malik, Ramni Gupta, Fakhar Ul Haider, Balwan Singh
papers.abstract: Uses topological data analysis, TopoPointNet/BDT classification, and a density filter to recover simulated critical intermittency scaling in eta-phi point clouds.

papers.title: The Living Guide of Machine Learning for Particle Physics
papers.authors_short: Claudius Krause, Ramon Winterhalder, Matthew Feickert, Benjamin Nachman
papers.abstract: Freezes the HEP-ML Living Review through June 1, 2026 and replaces it with a curated, annotated Living Guide for a mature and rapidly diversifying field.

papers.title: Silent coverage failures in rare-event searches and a degeneracy index that predicts them
papers.abstract: Studies interval coverage under model misspecification in Poisson counting, dark-matter spectra, and neutrinoless-double-beta searches, introducing a Poisson-Fisher degeneracy index.

papers.title: Alpha Particle Induced Collision Cascade Fusion
papers.authors_short: Sandeep Puri, Noah D'Amico, Andrew Gillespie, Ian Jones, Cuikun Lin, Bo Zhao, R. V. Duncan
papers.abstract: Reports small neutron excesses from a Po-210/deuterium setup and interprets them as D-D fusion via an alpha-induced collision-cascade mechanism with MCNP agreement.
